title: Shangri-La Frontier: Kusoge Hunter, Kamige ni Idoman to su 2nd Season
content:
How do I even approach this. SLF is a weird case for me because on paper, even prior to watching the first season, I’ve always looking down on it as yet another seasonal slop throwaway show that needs no bearing or chance. But thankfully, I made the jump and I loved the first season, mostly.

Come around season 2 is airing, I thought I would give it sometime to stack episodes and jump on it when it approaches its end, turned out it took me a year and 3 months to get through all of it. Pretty rough for a recommendation I guess.

The season started decently,I can’t name one very strong moment early on, however, I can tell you, the middle part was a SLOOOOOG to get through. Boring arc, boring dialog, un-engaging fights and he list runs longer. I took months-long breaks in-between but the water arc was almost the final nail on the coffin for me.

Thankfully, I decided to own it and I forced myself to watch the last 5 remaining episode. OMG this is the most fun I’ve had with this show yet, coincidentally it was focused more on the IRL interaction than the boring water slog. I guess my problem was with the arc itself, or perhaps the prolonged absence of Katzo and Pencilegon.
